_comment: The hub doc has no heading styles, so section titles are whatever oversized line started the section — often a mid-sentence fragment. These curated names replace them in the UI; the original text is kept as orig_title. Keys are the generated section ids; if the community rewrites a section's opening line its id changes and the original title simply shows again.
